serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Nun: And what the *beep* are you doing?
Nun: …{{wi}} I can’t believe you censored *beep* you Priestcan. {{wi}}COULD YOU STOP ALREADY! *Beep* is not even a swear word!
Ecclesiasticalot FF: My bleep censor function is working in advance. Even if you tell me you are going to use ‘freak’ you are categorized in my database as a highly unpredictable individual. There’s no telling if you are really going to say ‘freak’ or not.
Nun: Just chill for now! Can’t you see that this guy started leaving! You almost scared him away!
#Priestbot.Face.botFaceNeutral(instant)
Ecclesiasticalot FF: … Well, I will omit the fact that I didn’t start this argument. I apologize on behalf of both of us. This behavior does not represent what this church’s community stands for.
#Nun.Face.nunFaceThinking
Nun: *in a whisper* What community, only I come here regularly. 
Wha…{{wi}} There is something wrong with these guys. I’m glad that they calmed down though.
#Nun.Face.nunFaceNormal
Ecclesiasticalot FF: So… How can I help you young man?
Nun: Wow! So you can be nice to someone from time to time!
Ecclesiasticalot FF: …
You: Well. Last time I asked you some questions about the Church, but our talk was cut short, because of your update, sooo…{{wi}} I came to talk some more. 
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Ahhh, yes. Shanice, could we please… finish our talk later?
Nun Shanice: No problem. Maybe I will learn something new too.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Probability of that is… rather high. That’s a good idea actually. 
#Nun.Face.nunFaceSerious
Nun Shanice: He made fun of me again, didn’t he.
I kinda wonder what kind of relationship these two have. 
Ecclesiasticalot FF: What do you want to ask?
You: I thought you were alone in this church, but you got here a pretty nun. Did something change?
#Nun.Face.nunFaceHappy
Nun Shanice: Geez~ He said I’m pretty~ Thank you!
S-she liked that. Hehe. Maybe I got a chance with her…
You: Um-m, by the way, I’m Anon.
Nun Shanice: Oh, hi Anon! I’m Shanice…
#Nun.Face.nunFaceNormal
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Going back to your question, nothing changed. You see...{{wi}} Shanice isn’t really a nun.
Shanice: But I will become one!
Ecclesiasticalot FF: I don’t want to upset you, but that is quite improbable. 
#Nun.Face.nunFaceAngry
Future nun Shanice: And why exactly is that?!
Ecclesiasticalot FF: You wear inappropriate clothes that mock nuns and you are not even baptised.
Wait, what? Is she a cosplayer or something?
'Nun' Shanice: You stick to the details too much. Besides, I asked you for baptism and you denied me several times!
Ecclesiasticalot FF: I have my reasons for that. 
'Nun' Shanice: Reasons? Like what?!
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Please, we can talk about it at a later time. 
#Nun.Face.nunFaceSerious
'Nun' Shanice: Whatever…
Ecclesiasticalot FF: …
It became kinda… {{wi}}awkward.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Now that I explained to you about Shanice, we can move on!
You: Oh, right. 
Ecclesiasticalot FF: You can ask your question now.
